تعرنكسون (form IIIq)
# تَعْرَنْكِسُونَ (taʕrankisūna) /taʕ.ran.ki.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# تُعْرَنْكَسُونَ (tuʕrankasūna) /tuʕ.ran.ka.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
